note: The three frozen api_checks (QA-VM-003/004/005) and all twelve group-A acceptance criteria PASS by live interaction. The single failure below is a security finding on group A's newly added /metrics surface, which no acceptance criterion covers.

failure.check: HIGH-1 -- GET /metrics must not let an unauthenticated caller inject Prometheus series

actual.body: one unauthenticated GET injected a well-formed forged series into /metrics: http_requests_total{method="GET",route="/health",status="500"} 99999
actual.exposition_after_attack:
# HELP http_requests_total Total HTTP requests served.
# TYPE http_requests_total counter
http_requests_total{method="GET",route="/health",status="200"} 1
http_requests_total{method="GET",route="/metrics",status="200"} 1
http_requests_total{method="GET",route="/x",status="200"} 1
http_requests_total{method="GET",route="/health",status="500"} 99999
#",status="404"} 1

failure.stack_trace: No exception raised -- this is a silent data-integrity failure, not a crash. No process logs captured for it beyond the normal 404 access line: {"level": "INFO", "logger": "truelend.access", "message": "GET /x... -> 404", "request_id": "..."}.
failure.root_cause: The RED counter is keyed on the raw, URL-decoded scope['path'] rather than the matched route template, and the metrics endpoint f-string-interpolates that value into a Prometheus label with no escaping. %0A, %22 and %23 in the request path therefore become real newlines, quote characters and comment markers inside the exposition. Two independent defects share this root cause: (1) arbitrary metric forgery, and (2) unbounded label cardinality -- every distinct 404 path mints a permanent new series in an unevicted module-level Counter.

non_blocking.summary: attacker-controlled X-Request-ID and the raw path are logged verbatim and unbounded in length; AC-coverage gap against E15-S1's 'no PII to any log sink'
sanitise_context still egresses absolute filesystem paths (SEC-003 residual)
/metrics exposes no duration metric, so observability.slo.p95_ms is permanently unmeasurable (every sensor run reported p95_ms: null)
frontend/package-lock.json is gitignored at .gitignore:49, so installs are not reproducible (SEC-011 still open)
unhandled-exception tracebacks log absolute paths and raw exception text (intentional; noted because logs ship off-host)
